BOS@HOU.note: Two top-five net ratings: Houston is second (+12.2) with the league's best offense, Boston fifth (+9.2). Boston plays on no rest and rests Paul George.

POR@DEN.note: Portland is third in net rating (+11.0) and 3-0 on the road, yet Denver (19th) is a 4.5-point favorite. Ja Morant is out for the Blazers.

MIA@LAL.note: Lakers -1.5 is the closest spread tonight. Luka is off a 45-point night, but the Lakers play on no rest and rank 19th on defense.

OKC@CLE.note: 4-2 vs 4-2 on NBCSN. Oklahoma City is 17th in net rating and missing Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Wallace and Caruso.

WAS@ORL.note: Washington (+0.8 net, 15th) is only a 2.5-point underdog at Orlando (-8.8, 25th), which plays on no rest without Banchero and Anthony Black.

NOP@MEM.note: Memphis goes for 7-0 with the league's best net rating (+14.7), second on both offense and defense.

TOR@LAC.note: Both teams played Sunday. Toronto (7th in net rating) is a 5.5-point road favorite without Kawhi Leonard; the Clippers have lost five straight.

PHX@GSW.note: Curry (rest) and Green (back) sat Sunday and Golden State plays on no rest. Phoenix ranks 27th in net rating.

ATL@IND.note: Indiana is without Haliburton, Siakam, Nembhard, Nesmith and Zubac, so Atlanta is a 10.5-point road favorite.

BKN@NYK.note: Knicks 88.6% to win, the highest on the board. Brooklyn plays on no rest after its first win.

CHI@PHI.note: East-leading Philadelphia is a 10.5-point favorite. Chicago plays the fastest pace in the league but ranks 29th in net rating.

DET@CHA.note: Detroit has the league's best defense (101.0 per 100 possessions). The 210.5 total is the lowest tonight.

MIL@MIN.note: Minnesota is fourth in net rating even after losing Anthony Edwards, who was +16.0 per game. Milwaukee ranks 28th.

SAC@DAL.note: Sacramento (0-6) is last in net rating (-17.9). Dallas lists Kyrie Irving as doubtful.

UTA@SAS.note: San Antonio -16.5 is the largest line tonight. The Spurs have won four straight; Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr.
